title: Map primary-source readiness for the next How We Know library
objective: In parallel with Case 002 setup, independently verify the primary-source identity, availability, licensing, claim boundary, likely dependence structure, counterevidence seeds, and bounded corpus feasibility for the GPT-4 bar-exam percentile, Mehrabian 7-38-55, and fact-check-effectiveness candidate cases without producing or admitting a dossier.
required_evaluation: primary or authoritative work, DOI, edition, and publication-identity verification for each candidate
credential-free access, open-access or quotation boundary, license, snapshot, and stable-retrieval assessment
circulated proposition versus tested or reported proposition comparison
known, shared, and unresolved data, method, author, material, citation, comparison-class, and derivation-lineage mapping
active counterevidence, qualification, correction, reply, and supersession seed search
bounded corpus-size and review-cost estimate with explicit uncertainty
fresh-clone independent review of source identities and every go, hold, or fail recommendation
full deterministic make check, disclosure audit, exact path-scope comparison, and clean tracked state
acceptance: three separate preliminary packets cover GPT-4 bar-exam percentile, Mehrabian 7-38-55, and fact-check effectiveness without combining them into one dossier or one evidentiary count
each packet distinguishes verified source identity and access facts from unverified retrieval leads, interpretation, expected topology, and editorial recommendation
the GPT-4 packet checks the original model report, underlying score study, authoritative comparison-population data, the Martinez re-analysis, and the provenance of the top-10-percent derivation

the Mehrabian packet checks both 1967 primary studies, the cross-study combination step, the author's later public qualification, and a bounded sample of current recirculation while keeping the circulated and tested propositions separate

the fact-check packet checks the four-country experiment, broad evidence review, 2023 science-misinformation meta-analysis, 2025 reply, durability and behavior boundaries, and source-program overlap with Case 001
each packet records exact URLs, identifiers, retrieval dates, media types, access status, license or quotation treatment, and unresolved artifacts without inventing missing values
each packet ends with a provisional go, hold, or fail recommendation tied to source closure, corpus size, risk, and machinery value rather than perceived importance
reported numbers from prior model-generated notes receive no evidentiary credit until independently read from an authoritative source
the work retains negative searches, inaccessible sources, conflicting identities, and unresolved derivations
no candidate is described as researched, accepted, reviewed, settled, published, or ready to feature merely because preliminary mapping succeeded
the result remains preliminary research and does not alter the public catalog, Case 001, application code, policies, workflows, or generated outputs
make check passes without changing accepted source state
limitations: Only credential-free public reads are authorized; do not create accounts, accept provider terms, use secrets, purchase access, or initiate billable research services.
This task records source readiness and candidate topology, not complete literature reviews, effect-size estimates, verdicts, or admission receipts.
Copyrighted works may be represented by metadata, access receipts, digests where available, and quote-minimal fair-use spans; do not commit unauthorized full text.
The three candidates may be researched in parallel, but their source artifacts, conclusions, lineages, and recommendations must remain independently reviewable.
No agent trace pilot, dossier construction, feature selection, policy change, compiler change, workflow mutation, deployment, publication, DNS action, package release, or spend is authorized.
